Comment.value: Crash Party event item. Plot+Cursed on purpose: undroppable, unsellable, unstealable, unbankable. Cursed means 'cannot be dropped' only, so a worn one can still be taken off. Charges live in the CP_USES item local (cp_inc.nss) and are never shown to the player. ON-HIT item: OnHitCastSpell -> ONHIT_UniquePower (iprp_onhitspell 125) reaches the stock X2_S3_OnHitCast, which runs the item's TAG as a script because onmoduleload enables tag-based scripting. No dispatcher override needed. One charge per PROC (20% of hits), not per swing.
